entries.headline: Junior Caminero connected at +209
entries.story: Junior Caminero cashed. Facing Jacob Lopez, he went deep in the 8th in his 4th at bat. The call: "Junior Caminero homers (34) on a line drive to left center field. Yandy Díaz scores. Jonathan Aranda scores." Final line: 1-for-5.

entries.headline: Hunter Goodman stayed in the yard
entries.story: Hunter Goodman went 0-for-2 with 1 BB against Michael Soroka and the Arizona Diamondbacks. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber came close
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 2-for-3 with 2 BB and 1 RBI against Hunter Dobbins and the St. Louis Cardinals. Closest call was a double in the 7th: "Kyle Schwarber doubles (14) on a sharp fly ball to center fielder Nathan Church. Garrett Stubbs scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.
